summary.text: Sergio Muñoz is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 36 who has represented the district since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Sergio Muñoz Jr.'s committee assignments in the 2023-2024 legislative session were Ways & Means and Defense & Veterans' Affairs.
In 2021-2022 he served on the Higher Education and Pensions, Investments and Financial Services committees.
